column1: # check-wasm-oracle.ts and the browser tests accept another sha256 for these
# files only; every other output must stay byte-identical. Cause, for all of
# them: glibc (native) and emscripten's libm (WASM) differ by 1 ulp on a few %
# of sin/cos/tan/atan/atan2/asin/acos/pow calls. Remove an entry as soon as
# the file becomes identical (the check reports it).
